name: Guarded Thunderbrew Barrel
summary: In Kharanos, the Thunderbrew family's ale rests under guard in the distillery cellar. The watch protects their prized stock from thieves and rivals.

sections.title: A Cellar Under Watch
sections.body: Jarven Thunderbrew keeps watch over the Thunderbrew family's ale in the cellar beneath their distillery in Kharanos. In Dun Morogh, the family trusts no one with its stock; sentries stand beside the aging casks to keep anyone from tampering with or siphoning away the brew.

sections.title: Family Pride and Rivalries
sections.body: The Thunderbrews take pride in their proprietary recipes, especially their potent batches of Thunder Ale. Dwarves treat brewing with the care they give smithing and mining. Troggs creep through Dun Morogh, and brewing rivals compete across the Alliance. Jarven watches the casks so the family's ale stays untouched until it is ready to be tapped.

faq.q: Why can't I open this barrel?
aliases: why cant i touch the ale
faq.answer: Jarven Thunderbrew is standing watch in the basement. While he guards the barrels, no one may disturb the Thunderbrew family's stock.
Jarven Thunderbrew is a member of the Thunderbrew clan, stationed in the Kharanos distillery cellar. He watches the family's finest ales and stops thieves or troublemakers from tampering with them.
The barrel is in the cellar beneath the Thunderbrew Distillery, in Kharanos, Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why do the Thunderbrews guard their ale so closely?
faq.answer: The Thunderbrews guard their ale because brewing is a revered craft and family legacy to dwarves. Rival brewers, thieves, troggs, and leper gnomes threaten rare vintage barrels of Thunder Ale.

faq.q: Is this part of another quest?
faq.answer: Yes. You help Marleth Barleybrew with Bitter Rivals by sneaking a barrel of Barleybrew Scalder among the Thunderbrews' barrels of Thunder Ale.

faq.q: Can you distract or move Jarven?
faq.answer: Yes. Jarven has orders not to touch the stock, though he admits he would love a taste of Thunder Ale. Bringing him one draws his attention from the barrels.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know a family's secret brew is worth defending with your life and limb. Jarven's stubborn watch in the cellar comes naturally.
As a rogue, you know a quiet cellar heist is harder with a vigilant dwarf watching the keg.
